snippet.title: Chosen by Odin - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Chosen by Odin today! Hunt the cults of Ragnarök across epic Norse realms in this 1-3 player co-op action game. Wield Godly powers, roll dice to shape mighty builds with your friends, and escape as overwhelming hordes close in. Return to Valhalla, grow stronger, and rewrite the saga. Developed and published by Bedtime Digital Games.
